pre-edit.description: Deny edits to test/lint configs, team.json, TDD state, settings and hook files (prevents passing by weakening the gate)
Red-green-refactor gate on source files, driven by verified test-run state

pre-bash.description: Flag shell writes (redirects, sed -i, tee, mv/cp, touch of override files) into gated or protected paths

post-edit.description: Append source/test edit events to the counter logs (consumed by gate budgets and delivery accounting)
Fire-and-forget incremental code-review-graph update, circuit-broken on repeated failure

post-bash.description: Derive TDD state from observed test runs: confident failure sets red; only the wrapper sets green

session-start.description: Record session baseline (SHA, dirty files) and inject sanitized invariants, TDD/gate status, and version warnings

stop.description: Deterministic completion checks scoped to terminal pipeline phases; heuristics warn only
